name: NutriFit-AI calorie & protein requirement models
label_construction: Katch-McArdle BMR where body fat is measured, else Mifflin-St Jeor; FAO/WHO PAL multiplier; goal-specific energy adjustment and ISSN protein coefficient sampled within published ranges; Gaussian residual noise. See ml/nutrifit/labels.py.
intended_use: Nutritional guidance for healthy adult gym users. Not a medical device; not for clinical populations, pregnancy, or eating disorders.
known_limitations: Trained on 973 records; Random Forest is data-starved at this scale.
Fitness goals are synthetically assigned, not self-reported.
No allergy, medical-condition or dietary-restriction handling.
Body fat is Deurenberg-estimated when not user-supplied.
